document.title: [Bug][Spec Decode] DSpark corrupts thinking/chat outputs on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (all k; both v0.32.0 and nightly; clean without speculation)
document.body:
## Environment

- Hardware: 8x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 96G (SM120), single node, TP8 + EP
- vLLM: **0.32.0 release** and **0.32.1rc1.dev24** (latest nightly) — both reproduce
- torch: 2.13.0+cu132 (release env) / 2.14.0+cu132 (nightly env) — both reproduce
- FlashInfer: 0.7.1rc5 (python + jit-cache; cubin 0.7.0.post1)
- Checkpoint: `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` (site copy, 48 shards)
- Local patch: #60762 (SM120 uniform-64 block-size declaration only — 2 files, declaration-level; symptom is identical with/without it)
- Flags: `--tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --trust-remote-code --enable-expert-parallel --block-size 64 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}' --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 --max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 128 --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":N}'`

## Symptom

With DSpark enabled, `/v1/chat/completions` in thinking mode returns degenerate loops in the reasoning stream (e.g. `"to invoketo invoke..."`, `"*75*75*75..."`) and no structured tool calls are produced. Plain-text `/v1/completions` is **not** affected: a 25-tier benchmark suite (1K ladder c1-c128, long-context 32K-1M, 64K/64K ramp) ran with speculation on, all zero failures, and a 256-prompt needle-retrieval task scored 99.6% coherent — so the corruption is specific to the chat/thinking format.

## Isolation (every variable tested on the same box)

| Configuration | chat/thinking output |
|---|---|
| 1017 + DSpark k=3, vLLM nightly (torch 2.14) | degenerate loops |
| 1017 + DSpark k=3, vLLM 0.32.0 (torch 2.13) | degenerate loops |
| 1017 + DSpark k=4 / k=5 / k=7 | degenerate loops |
| **1017, no speculation (same boot, same parsers)** | **clean**: reasoning/content correctly separated (`17*19` -> reasoning "We need answer only number..." + content `323`); tools -> structured `tool_calls` (`get_gpu_alert({"node":"gpu-03"})`); 12-turn tools-API agent session 12/12, 0 errors |
| Original `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` + DSpark k=3, same hardware/config family | clean (prior deployment records on this box: 26-32 structured tool calls, 0 errors) |

Also ruled out: tokenizer files (byte-identical between the two checkpoints), template rendering (vLLM's built-in `deepseek_v41` template output is byte-identical to the official `encoding/encoding.py` reference for single-turn chat), tokenization (`/tokenize` parses the special tokens into their single IDs correctly), sampling temperature (0.0 and 1.0 both corrupt), and the parser flags (no-spec run uses the same three flags and is clean).

## Repro (minimal)

```bash
vllm serve <DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017> --tensor-parallel-size 8 --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --block-size 64 \
  --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}' \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41

curl .../v1/chat/completions -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"17*19=? answer with the number only"}],"max_tokens":512,"temperature":0}'
# with spec: reasoning = repetitive token loops; without --speculative-config: reasoning "..." + content "323"
```

## Context

- The encoder/renderer sync PRs #62199 / #62196 / #62200 address the tool-result turn encoding delta from DeepSeek's `314113f` encoding fix — a separate problem. Our corruption is single-turn, reproduces on the current encoder, and flips solely on speculation.
- #58485 reports a related class (spec decode x thinking markers) on another model family.
- 1017 is a weight-only update of V4.1-Flash (config/tokenizer unchanged; the release notes describe shortened outputs/agent tuning), so the delta is in the fine-tuned `mtp.*` draft heads or their interaction with the verifier in thinking-format contexts.

## Impact / workaround

Chat or agent serving on the 1017 checkpoint should disable DSpark speculation until this is fixed (plain-text completion workloads are unaffected). Happy to run any follow-up experiment on this box.
